prompt:
You write realistic customer-support messages for testing a router.

Write 12 different messages, 1-3 sentences each, in a customer's own voice, varied in tone and detail. Never use the words of the description literally.

The customer believes their situation is: someone else got into their account. They describe it that way, sincerely and plainly (they are mistaken, but the message must read as that situation).

Answer with JSON only: {"messages": ["...", ...]}

messages: I can’t sign in anymore, and the password reset email went to an address I don’t recognize. I’m worried another person has taken over my profile.
There’s a purchase in my history that I didn’t make, and the delivery address isn’t mine. Please help me secure my account.
I got an alert about a login from another country while I was asleep. I think my account has been accessed without my permission.
My profile photo and contact email were changed overnight. I didn’t make those changes, so I believe somebody has been using my account.
I keep getting signed-out notifications, and my saved devices list shows a phone I’ve never owned. Can you check whether my account is compromised?
I received a password reset message I never requested, followed by a notice that my password had been updated. I’m locked out now.
There are messages in my inbox that I didn’t send. It looks like another person is using my account, and I need help stopping them.
I noticed a new payment method on my profile that isn’t mine. I’m certain I didn’t add it, and I’m concerned my account was accessed by someone else.
My order history has several unfamiliar items, and the shipping details have been changed. I didn’t authorize any of this.
I got an email saying my account was signed in from a new browser, but I haven’t used any other device. Please help me figure out what’s going on.
The recovery phone number on my profile has been replaced with a number I don’t recognize. I think someone has taken control of my account.
I can still get into the app, but my settings and recent activity look completely different. I didn’t change them, and I’m worried another user has access.
